messages:
maria: Morning — ran the nightly attn bench and noticed a p99 jump on fused-attn kernels in the H100 pool. p50/p95 look normal. Run id: 2026-03-18_03:22. Anyone else seeing noise around that time?

alex: Saw the spike too, ~+40ms at p99 on mixed workloads. It started after the kernel-selector heuristic tweak (PR #4122) and a runtime image bump last week.

jon: Can you paste the bench command and the exact config (seq distribution + batch mix)? Need to reproduce locally.

maria: Command: `./bench --suite=attn_tail --pool=h100 --runs=20 --seq-dist=prod_sample.json --batch-mix='[1,4,8]' --seed=42`
Logs: /tmp/bench-20260318.log (snippet below)
`[INFO] warmup done, measuring`
`[DEBUG] kernel_selector: seq=512 score=0.53 chose=fused_attn_v2 alt=fused_attn_v1`

sam: Quick check — are these warm measurements? p99 is very sensitive to cold starts and fallback activity.

maria: Warm. Harness does a 2000-token warmup per worker. Grep for fallback: `grep -c fallback /tmp/bench-20260318.log` => 0.

alex: Note: I changed kernel-score threshold from 0.6 -> 0.55 last week which can flip near-boundary seq lengths. Selector debug should show borderline picks.

jon: Selector trace shows a lot of borderline picks around seq=384..512. Example: `KSEL: seq=512 score=0.53 chosen=fused_attn_v2 alt=fused_attn_v1` — that matches maria's log.

maria: Interesting: the regression is concentrated on batch=8 samples; batch=1/4 p99 unaffected. Hypothesis: batch packing alters tile layout leading to lower throughput for fused_attn_v2 on H100 in the new runtime image. Also infra rolled runtime image with CUDA 12.2 this week.

sam: Proposal: A/B experiments — (A) revert threshold to 0.6, (B) run bench on previous runtime image (pre-CUDA-12.2). This should isolate selector config vs driver/image.

alex: I'll run both experiments on a small harness (10 runs each, same seed) and post run ids.

ci-bot: Job queued: bench/1768887777-expt1 (kernel_threshold=0.6), bench/1768887777-expt2 (runtime=image:2026-03-10). ETA ~25m.

jon: Also please add a microbench for raw kernel latency at the problem shapes: seq {384,512,1024}, batch=8. Command: `microbench/kernel_latency.py --kernel=fused_attn_v2 --seq=512 --batch=8 --runs=50` — get distribution of kernel-level tail.

maria: I'll collect perf counters (sm__cycles_elapsed, achieved_flops, l2_hit_rate) for the microbench to see if achieved FLOPS drops with the new image.

alex: Initial results: expt1 (threshold revert) p99 ~= baseline (no regression). expt2 (runtime=image:2026-03-17) p99 ~= nightly +38ms. So reverting selector threshold didn't fix it; image correlates.

jon: That points at driver / runtime libs. Can you diff CUDA/cuDNN/lib versions between images?

maria: Image image:2026-03-10 (good) -> CUDA 12.1, libcudnn 9.0. image:2026-03-17 (bad) -> CUDA 12.2, libcudnn 9.1. Will run microbench with both images and attach counters.

sam: If the microbench confirms, we should rollback the canary image and open an infra ticket for a coordinated vendor escalation. Also add a nightly that runs these microbenches to detect such regressions earlier.

alex: Opened INF-879: "p99 tail regressions on H100 after CUDA 12.2 image". Assigned infra-image team. Link: https://redwood.atlassian/browse/INF-879

ci-bot: INF-879 created and watchers added: alex, maria, jon, sam.

maria: Next steps: (1) alex -> run microbench across seqs/batches with both images and upload perf traces; (2) jon -> add kernel-level counters and selector debug to nightly bench; (3) sam -> schedule rollback on canary H100 pool if microbench confirms. I'll consolidate numbers and update INF-879.

alex: Running microbenches now. Will post raw csv and flame traces when complete.

maria: Thanks — if we confirm image is root cause we should add an explicit image-smoke gate before rolling to canary pools. :thumbsup:

sam: Agreed. Also will add a short note to the runtime RFC follow-up about adding image/version to bench metadata (so future triage has that baked in).

jon: Adding that to the bench harness checklist: record image:tag, driver versions, full selector trace for any p99 > baseline +10ms.

maria: I'll close out here once the microbench artifacts are in INF-879. Thanks everyone.
